name: optiscaler-fixed
description: the same box as `optiscaler`, with the mod as installed: the regression guard for 71963f6, which stopped the overlay creating a discovery swapchain at all

report.thread: the fix shipped in 1.3.0; he was answered and the task archived
report.verdict: this profile has no report of its own. It is `optiscaler` with the bug fixed, and its job is to fail the day the fix regresses

payloads.note: identical to `optiscaler` — the configuration is the same box; only `mod.build` and `expect` differ

expect.note: the fix is not the absence of a crash — a crash can stop for any number of reasons. It is the mod reading its hook addresses off the swapchain the ENGINE owns, which it says in its own log, so that line is what this profile asserts.
log_lines: hooks: from the engine's own swapchain

manual.rtss: RTSS 7.3.5 here, 7.3.7 in the report. The apply starts it if it is not already up and the restore stops it again; RTSS the owner already had running is left alone at both ends.
manual.driver_vsync: the owner's word — not readable from a script
manual.monitors: three: 1920x1080 @ 75 Hz primary, 1920x1080 @ 100 Hz, 1080x1920 @ 75 Hz rotated; the game runs on the primary
